questions.question: To whom does the psalmist lift his eyes in Psalm 123?
options: The king, who sits upon his throne
The hills, from which his help will come
God, who is enthroned in the heavens
The temple, where his glory dwells
questions.answer: God, who is enthroned in the heavens

questions.question: To what does the psalm compare looking to the LORD?
options: As a watchman waits for the coming morning
As a farmer watches the sky for the early autumn rain
As the eyes of servants look to their master's hand
As a weaned child rests against its mother
questions.answer: As the eyes of servants look to their master's hand

questions.question: The psalmist asks for mercy because they have had more than enough of contempt.
To you I lift up my eyes, O you who are enthroned in _____!
Our eyes look to the LORD our God, till he has _____ upon us.
